app_profile_heap_snapshot.reason: Headless CLI environment lacks Chrome DevTools Protocol / Dart VM memory profiler dump pipeline for full app profile mode. Unit/Provider harness serves as supporting evidence only.

sanitization_notes: 100% sanitized. Contains no raw bank account numbers, passwords, JWTs or PII.
methodology: Dart VM WeakReference target observation combined with generational garbage collection allocation pressure on Provider/VM harness. Directly probes object retention across Owner -> Logout -> Cohost -> Member lifecycle.
limitations: Measured in Dart VM Runtime Test Harness under Windows 64-bit environment. Full Chrome DevTools Protocol .heapsnapshot dump on production Web build is NOT RUN. Does NOT prove full app profile heap cleanliness beyond Provider harness scope. WeakReference target null means the harness no longer references the object; it is not a proof that every copy is gone from RAM. State remains Chờ review.
